verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec from LocalAI, and probes of common spec paths on localai.io (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. Being OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible is an adjacent feature: it implies an external vendor's spec might apply, but it is not LocalAI publishing its own machine-readable spec. Confidence is medium because the probes only covered the docs site, not a running LocalAI server.
